verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance and security platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only Oneleet's hosted platform: a cloud API at api.oneleet.com, OAuth sign-in, and a hosted MCP server. Nothing describes a self-hostable deployment, an on-prem option, or downloadable server software.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
